features: CONNECTIVITY: The mouse can be easily connected to a laptop, desktop or CPU via the USB Type A port.
AMBIDEXTROUS DESIGN: The ambidextrous design can be used by both the right hand and the left hand. It is easy to use and moves smoothly over most surfaces.
1000DPI OPTICAL SENSOR: Get better cursor control for precise tracking and text selection with the 1000DPI Optical Sensor
GREAT AESTHETICS: The sleek design makes this mouse an ideal fit for homes, offices, schools and other similar organisations.
